name: Vertiv
outlook:
What Vertiv says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: net salesExpects fourth quarter 2026 net sales of $4,413 million and organic sales growth of 50%, each at the midpoint of guidance, compared to fourth quarter 2025.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: diluted EPSExpects fourth quarter 2026 diluted EPS of $2.08 and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.25, each at the midpoint of guidance, an increase of 82% and 65%, respectively, compared to fourth quarter 2025.
  • Full year 2026: net salesExpects full year 2026 net sales of $14,650 million and organic sales growth of 38%, each at the midpoint of guidance, compared to full year 2025.
  • Full year 2026: diluted EPSExpects full year 2026 diluted EPS of $6.29 and adjusted diluted EPS of $7.15, each at the midpoint of guidance, an increase of 84% and 70%, respectively, compared to full year 2025.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresCapital expenditures for full year 2026 are still anticipated at approximately 4.0% of revenue, reflecting the continued investment Vertiv is making to capture increasing demand across its pipelines.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
